description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of slot types present in the dialogue state tracking dataset. The chart contains 13 slices, each representing a different slot type. The slices are labeled “date” (green, 19.30%), “from” (light blue, 17.00%), “to” (orange, 14.50%), “genre” (dark orange, 13.50%), “name” (dark blue, 5.20%), “size” (teal, 4.20%), “intent” (olive, 3.80%), “location” (yellow-green, 3.80%), “destination” (light green, 3.00%), “city” (pale yellow, 2.60%), “class” (pale orange, 2.40%), “range” (light peach, 2.20%), and “type” (light yellow, 2.00%), with a final slice labeled “passengers” (pale pink, 1.10%) and “beds” (beige, 1.30%). Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion. A legend is not present, but each slice is clearly labeled.
